decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the proposed demolition of an existing garage and erection of a new garage, as shown on drawing 755/02, Received 4th May 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the proposed demolition of an existing garage and erection of a new garage would be acceptable as it would be compatible with the size of the property, would maintain the amenity of the neighbouring properties and would maintain the appearance and character of the Chiswick House Conservation Area. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with Councils Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west or north facing wall of the garage hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Informatives: 

This application relates only to the proposed garage as depicted in the plan 755/02 and does not relate to any previous extensions to any other building on the property.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of a garage to rear garden to house
